primary_meaning: Any thought, word, deed, or disposition that transgresses God's law, misses the divine standard (hamartia), or rebels against God, producing guilt and separation from Him

alternatives.meaning: Inherited Adamic condition of guilt and corruption (original sin) transmitted to all humanity
A personified cosmic power or enslaving force that dwells in and dominates human nature
Primarily a relational rupture or spiritual sickness/alienation rather than forensic legal guilt

notes: Across historic Christian confessions the core denotation of sin as moral failure relative to God's will is settled; differences concern transmission, ontology, and juridical vs. therapeutic emphasis rather than the basic meaning itself.
